title: SPEC: zonoid
summary:
§G Zonoid subconscious layer operates above persistent memory substrate. Substrate stores experience/evidence; Zonoid forms memory, beliefs, frontiers, predictions, skills.
§C Artifacts=evidence not truth. History immutable. Identity persists across observations. Beliefs provisional. Graph=source of truth; embeddings=indexes only. Present overlay/frontier are generated, not persistent.
§I Unified memory graph nodes: Event, Artifact, Structural, Entity, Concept, Belief, Task, Metric. Edges: contains, references, observed_as, same_entity, instance_of, caused, fixed, blocked, depends_on, supports, contradicts. Retrieval modes: fact/entity/frontier/prediction.
§V Everything becomes timestamped event(actor/source/confidence/payload). Artifacts decompose into structured subgraphs. Entity resolution links observations to stable entities. Causality records why. Latent state=activation over graph. Skills=learned outputs, not graph structures.
